Matches NetworkX's `dfs_successors`. ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#6f74c1c5 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph().add_nodes(["A", "B", "C", "D"]) g.add_edges([("A", "B"), ("B", "C"), ("A", "D")]) {g.get_label_from_id(p): [g.get_label_from_id(c) for c in cs] for p, cs in g.dfs_successors("A").items()} ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {'A': ['B', 'D'], 'B': ['C']} ``` ::: :::
